activation.note: Requires: two evidences whose madluls conflict as contradiction or contrariety, on ONE subject, in one respect; otherwise the pair never enters the conflict protocol.

conflict_policy.note: Hukuma is prior to and different from takhsis: with hukuma the governed text is never preferred; with takhsis, preference of the specific's zuhur is itself required.

defeaters.note: Subject/respect difference; government (hukuma) relation, which is diagnosed lexically, not by tarjih.

exceptions.note: Where a third unconflicted dalil (e.g. an extant mutlaq) settles the locus, the case exits the conflict subject altogether.

principle.note: Explicit definitional statement with the unity condition stated as constitutive.

scope.note: Domain: pairs of probative evidences (adilla ijtihadiyya). Between a dalil and an asl 'amali there is no ta'arud at all, because the asl's subject is the thing qua unknown-of-ruling.

method_rules.title_fa: تعارض بدون وحدت موضوع و حیثیت تحقق نمی‌یابد

activation.note: Applies whenever a proposed 'jam'' requires extracting both texts from their zuhur without a qarinah; the judge of 'possibility' is 'urf.

conflict_policy.note: Murajjihat and takhyir are NOT postponed behind an unrestricted search for ta'wil; the 'ilaji akhbar and the ijma' of practice run the other way.

defeaters.note: 'Urfi jam' (e.g. building 'amm on khass) is not a defeater of this rule but its boundary: it was never the rejected form.

exceptions.note: Division 2 (nass/zahir) is not ta'arud; division 3 with an 'urfi azhar behaves like division 2.

principle.note: Explicit rejection with worked counterexample and the dawaran analysis: no priority for preserving zuhur over dropping one sanad.

scope.note: Negates the famous qa'ida in its claimed universality (jam' over tarjih at preference, jam' over takhyir at equality).

method_rules.title_fa: «الجمع مهما أمكن أولى من الطرح» قاعده‌ای کلی و مقدم بر ترجیح و تخییر نیست

activation.note: Requires a specific qarinah (textual/contextual, e.g. unity of utterance in Sama'a) or an 'urfi azhar; the resolution must be one 'urf accepts between two certainly-issued texts.

conflict_policy.note: Licensed jam' precedes all murajjihat because its locus is prior: where it succeeds there is no 'ilaj locus at all.

defeaters.note: A haml that 'urf counts as impossible between two issued utterances; equal divergent zuhurs (his own open ishkal).

exceptions.note: Makaseb 'udhrah: the species jam' is adopted as al-azhar only with the Sama'a qarinah and under an explicit conditional ('law urida al-tabarru' bi-l-haml'); the exact reconciliation with Faraid's division-1 rejection is a reconstruction, not Ansari's statement.

principle.note: Formulated from the 'urf-imkan criterion and the muhkam/mutashabih reading; the one-line formulation is reconstructive, hence B not A.

scope.note: Pairs of issued (or treated-as-issued) utterances where a dalala-resolution would work as it does inside a single utterance.

method_rules.title_fa: جمع دلالی فقط با قرینه یا أظهریت عرفی مشروع است؛ تبرّع به حمل جمع نیست

activation.note: A pair in which one side is nass (or azhar) relative to the other.

conflict_policy.note: All three internal murajjih types (sudur, jiha, madmun) are posterior to dalala-strength.

defeaters.note: Qummi's noted possibility that an external murajjih flips takhsis vs tajawwuz between two zahirs; Ansari treats it as outside the contested locus (from the standpoint of 'umum/khusus), not as a refutation.

exceptions.note: Recorded contrary practice (carrying a khass on taqiyya for agreement with the 'amma, Tusi in ziyada) is re-read by Ansari, not adopted; see MR-ANS-JIHA-BOUND.

principle.note: Explicit: 'al-aqwa dalalatan muqaddam ... la yanbaghi al-irtiyab'; and nass/zahir reduces to asala vs dalil al-hujjiyya (hukuma), not tarjih.

scope.note: Ordering inside the tarjih protocol and classification of nass/zahir pairs.

method_rules.title_fa: قوهٔ دلالت بر مرجحات صدوری، جهتی و مضمونی مقدم است؛ نص و ظاهر اصلاً تعارض ندارند

activation.note: Presupposes the shar'i duty to act on one of the two (from ijma' and the 'ilaji akhbar); on the pure-tariqiyya premise without that duty he himself denies a proof for tarjih by mere strength.

conflict_policy.note: Extension from stated murajjihat to unlisted ones runs through the stated 'ilal (less probability of contradicting reality; mark of truth/rushd; distance from falsehood).

defeaters.note: Counting a non-probative external factor that does not make the report closer to reality is 'musaamaha'; mere strength of personal zann is not the criterion (type-level crediting).

exceptions.note: The Maqbula's narrator traits are re-scoped by Ansari to the two judges; khabar-level order starts with shuhra. Exception handling is his own tawjih ('ghayr ba'id'), hence partial.

principle.note: Strong but derivation-laden commitment ('al-haqq anna tadqiq al-nazar...'), conditional on the takhyir-at-equality premise; graded B.

scope.note: After jam' fails and a maziyya exists on one side; extracted order for khabar-level murajjihat: shuhra/shudhudh, a'daliyya/awthaqiyya, mukhalafat al-'amma, mukhalafat mayl al-hukkam; agreement with the Book is i'tidad by a qat'i dalil, not an ordinary murajjih.

method_rules.title_fa: ترجیح واجب است و به مرجحات منصوصه منحصر نیست؛ ملاک، اقربیت به واقع و ابعدیت از باطل است

activation.note: Requires exhaustive search (fahs tamm) over murajjihat and established absence of any maziyya.

conflict_policy.note: Strictly posterior to jam' (licensed) and tarjih.

defeaters.note: The marfu'a-based 'work by what agrees with ihtiyat' is rejected (very weak); tawqquf akhbar do not defeat takhyir (locus-bound, P-11).

exceptions.note: Non-ruling amarat (lexicographers, rijal): equality yields tawqquf and return to the asl of the derivative mas'ala, not takhyir.

principle.note: Explicit prohibition wording: 'al-ruju' ila al-takhyir ghayr ja'iz illa ba'd al-fahs al-tamm'.

scope.note: Terminal stage of the khabar-conflict protocol for the mujtahid's own act; the mufti takhyirs the mustafti; the qadi's later-case switching is separately disputed by Ansari ('yushkil al-jawaz').

method_rules.title_fa: تخییر فقط پس از فحص تام از مرجحات و عند التکافؤ کامل رواست

activation.note: A genuine stop arises at: declared unresolved ishkal (his own 'mahall al-ishkal'), unestablished hujjiyya, or the Maqbula's deferral locus. The positive enumeration is assembled from loci, not stated as one rule — partial.

conflict_policy.note: Stop never competes with an established dalil; it is what remains when the protocol's earlier gates fail or are locus-bound.

defeaters.note: Takhyir akhbar defeat a generalized stop after failed tarjih in fatawa.

exceptions.note: Deferral (irja') is distinct from ihtiyat-in-action; conflating them is explicitly rejected.

principle.note: The locus-binding of tawqquf akhbar is explicit; the generalized formulation is mine, hence B.

scope.note: Akhbar al-tawqquf in the Maqbula operate at loss of murajjihat WITH possibility of reaching the Imam (deferral of the case); in the ihtiyat chapter their command in hukmi tahrimi doubt is read as irshad, not a shar'i duty of stopping.

method_rules.title_fa: توقف حکم عامی در شبهه نیست؛ اخبار توقف موضع‌بسته‌اند و توقف واقعی از دروازه‌های مشخص وارد می‌شود

activation.note: Requires the locus diagnosis of the asl (its subject: the thing qua unknown-of-ruling) — the asl was never in ta'arud with the dalil.

conflict_policy.note: Akhbar al-takhyir govern even asl-level devices (hukuma of takhyir over asalat al-itlaq per his insaf) — partial because the general ordering vs every asl is not stated in one place.

defeaters.note: In khabar-conflict over rulings, the 'ilaji akhbar displace the pure-tasaqut outcome with takhyir; agreement of one report with the asl is itself debated as a murajjih (recorded, not settled here).

exceptions.note: No dedicated exception passage was extracted in this pass; a targeted search of the istishab-conflict sections (Faraid v2, DB pp.335-350) is still outstanding.

principle.note: 'Muqtadahu al-ruju' ila al-usul al-'amaliyya' under the tariqiyya analysis; the shar'i overlay (takhyir) is what the akhbar add.

scope.note: Where neither report functions as a tariq in its specific content (tariqiyya analysis), and for non-ruling amarat at equality.

method_rules.title_fa: پس از سقوط یا تعادلِ طریق‌ها، مرجع اصل عملیِ همان مجراست، نه توقف نامحدود

activation.note: Mukhalafa counts because the stated 'illa is that truth/rushd lies in opposing them (a ghalibi, not da'imi, proposition).

conflict_policy.note: Jiha murajjihat rank inside the internal types, all posterior to dalala-strength.

defeaters.note: Where the only choice is drop-the-sanad vs ta'wil, ta'wil is determined; agreement alone never licenses discarding a text to escape interpreting it.

exceptions.note: Tusi's taqiyya-haml in the ziyada case is recorded; Ansari re-reads it (Udda/Istibsar basis or other qarinas) rather than endorsing agreement-alone as sufficient.

principle.note: 'Fa-la yanbaghi al-ta'ammul' wording is explicit for the ta'wil-over-tarh limb; the composite rule is graded B.

scope.note: Jiha (direction-of-issuance) assessment inside tarjih, and haml of a specific text on taqiyya.

method_rules.title_fa: مخالفة العامة مرجّحِ اقربیتی است، نه مجوز طرح متن خاص؛ عند الدوران، تأویل بر طرح سند مقدم است

notice: Preliminary grades are Muse research proposals (A/B-CANDIDATE, C, D, X per the C1 brief). No rule here is approved for the historical core. Only an independent scholarly reviewer can qualify a rule. Neutral operator keys refer to phase_c/operator_catalog.json (DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE).
source_edition_note: All Faraid/Makaseb page numbers are the corpus database edition; print edition UNIDENTIFIED (recorded as such per brief).
